# /etc/systemd/system/robotd.service
[Unit]
Description=Microduck robotd (v0.3 read-only commissioning)
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=exec
User=root
Group=radxa
ExecStart=/opt/robot/daemon/current/bin/robotd --params /etc/robot/feetech-ft5/robotd.toml --socket /run/robotd.sock --read-only
Environment=ORT_DYLIB_PATH=/opt/robot/onnxruntime/1.28.0/libonnxruntime.so.1.28.0
Environment=RUST_LOG=info
RuntimeDirectory=robotd
Restart=no
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/30-studio-commissioning.conf
# Studio commissioning drop-in; operator confirmed support on 2026-10-31.
# Commissioning startup actively turns servo torque OFF. Support the robot first.
# It does not run policy motion. Use only after the operator confirms support.
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/opt/robot/daemon/current/bin/robotd --params /etc/robot/feetech-ft5/robotd.toml --socket /run/robotd.sock --commissioning

# /etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzz-studio-bus.conf
# /run/microduck-helper/bus-held 在 = 主程序被 Microduck Studio 挡着（调舵机中）。要放开：在 Studio 里交还，或者重启。
# 装到 /etc/systemd/system/robotd.service.d/zzzz-studio-bus.conf，然后 systemctl daemon-reload（不会重启 robotd）。
# 为什么不用 systemctl mask --runtime：robotd.service 的本体在 /etc/systemd/system，/run 里的 mask 盖不住它
# （fork packaging/runtime.py 停 updaterd 也是这一招）。旗在 /run 里，断电、重启就没了，robotd 照常开机自启。
# 旗在的时候 systemctl start robotd 返回 0，但单元停在 inactive、ConditionResult=no——判起没起来别看退出码。
[Unit]
ConditionPathExists=!/run/microduck-helper/bus-held

# 第 3 步（Studio 交还不卸力）验收以后才打开下面两行，打开后再 daemon-reload。打开以后 fork 的 robotd
# 启动时会看交接标记；没有标记就跟 V167 完全一样。旧版 robotd 不认这个变量，打开了也没影响。
#[Service]
#Environment=MICRODUCK_HANDOVER_MARKER=/run/microduck-handover/handover.json
